svg.title: Share of annual revenue that Alphabet, Apple, and Meta report from Europe and from China
svg.desc: A chart of the share of fiscal 2025 revenue, in percent, each row labeled with the firm's logo: Alphabet from Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, 29; Apple from Europe, 27; Meta from Europe, 23; Apple from Greater China, highlighted, 16.
svg.text: SHARE OF ANNUAL REVENUE, FISCAL 2025, PERCENT
